reviewer: Codex independently compares source, nodes, labels, directions and qualifiers; not a human review

checks.quote: 育苗记录包含准备容器、播种和观察三个阶段。
checks.criterion: 明确三个阶段且语义包含关系可见
checks.evidence: r0/r1/r2 explicitly contain preparation, sowing and observation stages.

checks.quote: 清洗完成后可以装入基质。
checks.criterion: 清洗完成→可装基质，不能升级成唯一必需前提
checks.evidence: r3 keeps 清洗完成后可以; no only/necessary prerequisite is introduced.

checks.quote: 装好基质后，把种子放进浅孔并覆上一层薄土。
checks.criterion: 装基质之后播种覆土，动作完整
checks.evidence: r4 connects 装好基质 to placing seeds in shallow holes and covering thin soil.

checks.quote: 如果盘底持续积水，记录要求先排水，再暂停当天的浇水。
checks.criterion: 持续积水条件→先排水→暂停当天浇水，条件保留
checks.evidence: r7 records continuing waterlogging -> drainage; r8 then pauses watering that day.

checks.quote: 只有基质表层变干且盘底没有积水时，才需要再次浇水。
checks.criterion: 表层变干与无积水是共同必要条件，不能任一单独触发
checks.evidence: n16 keeps BOTH dry surface and no waterlogging; r9 uses 才需要.

checks.quote: 若出苗速度较慢，可以继续观察两天，也可以请管理员检查种子；
checks.criterion: 慢出苗下两种可选处理，不画成强制连续步骤
checks.evidence: r10/r11 retain slow-emergence condition and 可以/也可以; r12 is explicitly an alternative, n22 says no compulsory choice.

checks.quote: 每天需要记录湿度，出苗后再记录株高。
checks.criterion: 每天湿度记录，出苗后株高记录，时间限定
checks.evidence: n24 keeps 每天需要记录湿度; r13 starts at 出苗 and says 之后再 -> 记录株高.

checks.quote: 株高记录可用于比较同一批幼苗的变化，不能仅凭一天的株高判定种子品质。
checks.criterion: 比较变化作用及不能凭一天株高判定品质都可见
checks.evidence: r14 retains same-batch comparison; r15 has correct subject 仅凭一天的株高 -> 不能判定 -> 种子品质.

readability_notes: 32 nodes for 231 Chinese characters; temporal wording is repeated in r3/r4, so readability can improve without changing the semantics.
scope: Frozen check coverage and additional full-edge review; one output is not a population accuracy estimate
